identity.description: Linear: project management / issue tracking SaaS (linear.app). Developer docs at developers.linear.app, which now redirects to linear.app/developers. GraphQL API at api.linear.app/graphql.
identity.identity_notes: Developer docs describe the Linear issue/project tracker API (issues, projects, comments, documents). The assignment hint domain developers.linear.app redirects to linear.app/developers.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization code (access token valid 24 hours, refresh token expires 30 days after issuance) and client credentials (app actor, 30-day token, no refresh token; must be toggled on per OAuth2 app).
auth.token_refresh: Authorization-code refresh tokens: a successful refresh returns a new access token and refresh token with a new 30-day lifetime. Client-credentials tokens: request a new token after a 401.
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes: read (default), write, admin (user actor only, admin-level endpoints), plus app-actor-only scopes such as customer:read/write, initiative:read/write. Actor types: user (default) or app (for agents and service accounts).

access.production_restrictions: Pricing page lists 'Third-party app management' as Not included on the Free tier (included on Basic and higher), so creating/managing third-party OAuth apps may require a paid plan; not confirmed. Personal API keys and API/webhook access are listed as included on Free.

read_ops: finding/searching issues, projects, comments, documents (per official MCP docs)
write_ops: creating and updating issues, projects, comments, documents (per official MCP docs)
api.rate_limits: Pricing page: 'Standard limits' on Free/Basic, 2x standard on Business, 5x standard on Enterprise. Numeric per-hour limits not verified.
api.limitations: Breadth of the full GraphQL schema not directly verified; resource list comes from MCP and webhook docs. Rate limit numbers not established.

open_questions: Whether creating/managing a third-party OAuth app requires a paid plan given Free lists 'Third-party app management' as not included.
Whether workspace admin approval is required to install an OAuth app or create client-credentials tokens (not stated in fetched docs).
Numeric API rate limits (per hour/minute) for personal keys vs OAuth apps; only multiplier tiers were verified.
Full GraphQL schema breadth (REST availability, mutations coverage) was not directly verified.
Sandbox or trial environment availability is unknown; no sandbox documented in fetched pages.

Community MCP servers (nimblebraininc/mcp-linear, PyPI mcp-linear, npm linear-mcp-server) were found only via search; ownership and maintenance not fetched. One search summary said the npm linear-mcp-server (API-key based) is deprecated in favor of the official remote server; not verified on the source page.
